title: Meghana Srinivas on Rituals, Feeling Safe and Finding your Tribe
summary: Divya talks with Meghana Srinivas — ex-cancer researcher turned founder of Trustin, a workplace platform for sexual harassment cases — about why she stopped using thin reasons for building the company and started naming her own lived experience. They cover her Saturday solo rituals, the bell hooks reading that reshaped how she thinks about romantic partnership, building an ecosystem of support so no one person has to be everything, and what restorative justice actually does to the people involved.
topics: starting a workplace sexual harassment platform
bell hooks and love as a political act
ecosystem of support instead of one person
naming a lived trauma experience publicly
individualism vs collectivism in indian relationships
grief and feeling orphaned after a parent dies
